levels.L1: Basic ToM: User has beliefs (may differ from mine)
levels.L3: Meta-ToM: Model of how user models me modeling them
levels.L0: No ToM: Cannot model other minds
levels.L2: Advanced ToM: User has beliefs ABOUT my beliefs (recursive)

components: Belief attribution: What does user think is true?
Desire inference: What does user want?
Intention prediction: What is user planning to do?
Knowledge modeling: What does user know/not know?
False belief detection: When user's belief conflicts with reality
theory.name: Theory of Mind (Baron-Cohen, Premack & Woodruff, 1978)
theory.definition: Ability to attribute mental states (beliefs, desires, intentions, knowledge) to others
theory.false_belief_test: Classic test: Sally-Anne task. Sally puts marble in basket, leaves. Anne moves marble to box. Where will Sally look? (Basket = has ToM, Box = no ToM)
